paper.title: Physics-informed adaptive Kalman filter for contact force estimation in industrial robots considering model uncertainty
paper.author_code: Not obtained; this is a local reimplementation, not redistributed author software

local_theory: reproductions/PIAKF/面向机器人外力估计的结构化动力学学习与动量 Kalman 滤波.md
model_boundary: Existing UR5 rigid model, ideal joint-side torque motors, viscous damping, no dry friction or backlash; shared files are not modified
equations: x=[p;w], y=Mhat*v, u=tau_ref+Mdot_hat*v-c_hat-G_hat-tau_f_hat; S=0 with integrated continuous process noise
frame: Wrench ON robot, world components, about moving tool0 point, linear components first
changes_from_paper: Known-model prerequisite precedes any learned-dynamics implementation
An independent matching nominal model is disclosed; plant truth is not a measurement input
Actual actuator torque replaces current-derived torque with electrical/transmission errors
Nonzero wrench process noise and declared local covariance values replace the paper simulation settings
Frozen-coefficient closed-form discretization and Joseph covariance update
Directional finite differences for known-model Mdot; not the paper neural chain-derivative timing method
New learning probe uses a disclosed point inverse-dynamics loss and whole-trajectory 4/1/1 split
Learned viscous friction matches the substitute plant, rather than the full printed Stribeck-style expression
No dropout is inferred from the undefined paper sparsity probability; static equilibrium supervision is a separate paired variant
Dynamic-only training excludes simulator component labels; the separate static-augmented variant adds synthetic equilibrium torque labels; regression logs are previously analyzed data
not_implemented: Paper complete friction and training specification
scientific_status: EXPLORE H-100/H-101 finite-condition reconstruction; archived observations, no claim-level evidence or full-paper completion

implemented_learning_scope.network: Three 128-node ReLU hidden layers; float64; 21-dimensional triangular inertia factor and direct six-dimensional gravity; learned nonnegative viscous friction
implemented_learning_scope.derivative: Explicit physical-q chain rule, checked against autograd and finite differences
implemented_learning_scope.training: Original dynamic-only: four no-contact trajectories, 1000 Adam updates, finite-difference acceleration; separate paired static variant: same initialization, data order and updates, plus 25 synthetic equilibrium torque labels with lambda=1
implemented_learning_scope.inference: Learned dynamic quantities; MuJoCo only for tool0 kinematics in learned adapter; same MomentumKF backend
implemented_learning_scope.validation_status: Executed known-dynamics checks, network checks, collection/training/replay and frozen component diagnostics; retained metrics and run index under conclusion/
